task: Implement the frozen combat revision in .ai/combat-spec.md: engine-owned enemy intents with injected RNG, per-hero tactical mechanics (Fighter combo/break/counter, Mage power recovery, Ninja opening/dodge counter/chain), lightweight boss phase 2, intent/status UI, and a naive-vs-smart balance simulation.
requirements: Follow .ai/combat-spec.md exactly; it is the controller-approved design. Where it says 'suggest', tune numbers in src/battle-data.js as needed for the balance tests.
All battle mechanics live in src/battle-engine.js with numbers in src/battle-data.js; src/battle-ui.js only renders state/intents and replays engine events.
Enemy intent is chosen once by chooseEnemyIntent with an injected rng and displayed before the player acts; resolveEnemyPhase executes exactly the stored intent.
Every hero keeps exactly four skills; no new systems beyond the spec.
Update test/battle.test.js with every test listed in section 5 of the spec, including the naive-at-Power-2 winnability over several seeds and smart-beats-naive on tier 3-4.
Update hero kanaSummary wording per spec section 4.

Append a dated entry to DESIGN_DECISIONS.md recording the principle 'Easy to play casually; rewarding to understand deeply.', the per-hero identities, engine-owned enemy intents, boss phase 2, only-Mage-regenerates-Power, and any balance tuning; revise the 'Balance is guarded by a simulation test' line. Update CURRENT_STATE.md status/test counts/next steps (revise stale lines, don't append).
constraints: Do not modify vocabulary, normalization, quiz modes, STT, TTS, quiz scoring, campaign.js Power formula, campaign stage order, or Study mode.
Keep the ?debug=battle launcher working; adapt it only if createBattle's options change.
Placeholder art only; add at most small CSS/data-state effects (break flash, enraged tint, heavy-intent pulse).
Battle view must still fit 1366x768 without vertical scroll.
Do not store DOM state or the rng function in battle state.
Edit source with structured edit tools; if a shell edit hits a quoting/escaping failure, switch to file edit tools.
Do not commit. Do not delete .ai/combat-spec.md.

behavioralAcceptance.description: Controller runs npm run test:browser with PLAYWRIGHT_PATH and screenshots a debug battle at 1366x768 to judge intent chips and feedback.
